title: LocalStorage via document.write
description: DOM-based XSS where a value read directly from localStorage is fed straight into document.write() with no intermediate function or wrapping.
objectives: Identify that the 'page' key is read from localStorage and passed to document.write() in a single line, with no processing in between.
Confirm that document.write() executes an injected <script> tag directly.
Observe that the payload persists across reloads until localStorage is cleared.
hints: The value goes straight into document.write(raw) — no escaping, no function boundary to trace through.
Reset the state with localStorage.removeItem('page') or localStorage.clear().
